task: Parse an AWS CloudWatch log entry and extract the timestamp, log level, and message using a regular expression
solution_criteria: The regex should correctly capture timestamp (ISO 8601 format), log level (ERROR, WARN, INFO, DEBUG), and the remaining message content from a CloudWatch log line

task: Create a Python function that validates an AWS S3 bucket name according to AWS naming rules (3-63 characters, lowercase, hyphens allowed, no consecutive hyphens, cannot start/end with hyphen)
solution_criteria: The function should return True for valid bucket names and False for invalid ones, correctly enforcing all AWS S3 bucket naming constraints

task: Generate a JSON configuration object for an AWS Lambda function that includes environment variables, timeout settings, memory allocation, and IAM role ARN
solution_criteria: The JSON should be valid, include all required Lambda configuration keys, have realistic values, and follow AWS Lambda configuration structure conventions
